API ReferenceZscaler Cellular APISim HandlingSim data file download
Sim data file download
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcell/config/api/v1/customers/:id/sims/download

Streams a CSV file directly to the response (content-type: text/csv). The response is not a JSON body — clients should treat it as a file download. The empty-body response model reflects that there is no JSON schema for the body.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED
QUERY PARAMETERS
sortBy
string
Default value: usage
sortDir
string
Default value: ASC
